question: What internal yogic process involving nectar and essence is undertaken even by the wise?
premises: A process involves the tip of nectar
It involves the essence of juice
Even a wise person undergoes this burning process
inference: Even the wise engage in a burning yogic process at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
uncertainties: The exact physiological or subtle-body referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are technical
plain_english: Even the wise, burning with the essence of juice at the tip of nectar...
